messages:
maya: Heads up — nightly aggregator on eu-edge dropped ~3.2M token events between 2024-12-02 02:00–02:40 UTC. Looks like the dedupe worker crashed and never forwarded to billing_ledger. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (largest), BeaconAI (smaller). Do we want a customer-facing credit or do an internal backfill?

maya: Quick query I ran against the aggregator shard: 
```sql
SELECT source_customer, SUM(token_count) as tokens_lost
FROM aggregator_events_staging
WHERE processed_at BETWEEN '2024-12-02 02:00' AND '2024-12-02 02:40'
  AND shard='eu-edge'
  AND forwarded_to_ledger=false
GROUP BY source_customer;
```

maya: Results: AcmeCorp = 2,400,000 tokens; BeaconAI = 600,000 tokens; misc = 200,000 tokens. Estimated billable delta if we backfill (using $0.0006/token): AcmeCorp ~$1,440; BeaconAI ~$360; misc ~$120 => total ~$1,920.

liam: thanks — can we confirm those tokens weren't double-counted elsewhere? any risk of double-billing if we backfill?

maya: I checked recent billing ledger batch ids. The forwarding id for that window is missing, so safe to backfill. No downstream duplicate id seen.

finance-bot: Ticket created: BILL-4721 — "eu-edge aggregator forwarding gap 2024-12-02". Assignees: billing-team, eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/BILL-4721

olivia: Thanks for the context. Two asks before I approve credits/backfill: 1) an approval note we can attach to the invoice export, 2) GL code for the credit/backfill so accounting can reconcile.

maya: proposed approval note: "Credit/backfill issued for missing forwarded events from eu-edge due to dedupe worker crash on 2024-12-02; totals validated by engineering and finance."

maya: GL code suggestion: 4001-RET-CREDIT. Also recommend we backfill the ledger (preferred) rather than issuing a manual customer credit — keeps usage continuity for audits.

sahil: root cause fixed — PR #3952 merged to restart the dedupe worker on transient failures. Deploy went out at 2024-12-02 03:20 UTC. I can run the backfill job against BILL-4721 if finance signs off. Backfill script dry-run output: 
```text
Dry run: will insert 3 records into billing_ledger for window 2024-12-02 02:00-02:40: AcmeCorp:+2400000 tokens, BeaconAI:+600000 tokens, misc:+200000 tokens
Estimated charges added: $1920
```

liam: if OLIVIA signs GL/code + note i'm fine with automated backfill. pls cc customer-success to preempt support tickets.

olivia: approved. Use GL 4001-RET-CREDIT, attach approval note above. Finance approves automated backfill and accounting reconciliation. cc @customer-success. :thumbsup:

maya: copying cs: @jess (customer-success) — FYI we'll backfill billing ledger and adjust invoices where needed. I'll post a short note to affected customers after backfill completes.

sahil: will run backfill now and report back once complete. Will update BILL-4721 with run logs.

finance-bot: BILL-4721 status -> In Progress (assignee: sahil).
